target_customer: Large and institutional real estate owners
problem: Property taxes across more than 20,000 jurisdictions are complex; TaxProper automates payments, forecasts liability and supports appeals.

founders.name: Thomas Dowling
prior_employers: Office of the Mayor of Chicago (advisor)
State of Illinois (appointed to oversee an agency)

founders.name: Geoff Segal
prior_employers: State Farm (actuarial statistician and research analyst)

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating tax bills, assessments and appeals rules across thousands of jurisdictions is data heavy but standard software.

defensibility.rationale: Jurisdiction data and workflow integration with owners could raise copy cost, though sources do not evidence it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Opendoor acquired TaxProper in 2022 per YC bios, described there as an eight figure deal, and used it for institutional property tax products.

market_need_then: Builtin described property tax appeals as time consuming and complex; Opendoor job text cites more than 20,000 property tax regimes.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name with no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: TaxProper raised a 2M seed in June 2020 led by Khosla Ventures and was acquired by Opendoor in 2022 in what founder bios on YC call an eight figure exit. A tiny funded team reached an acquisition within about three years in a niche enterprise market. The exit date is only a year and the price is a founder bio claim, so both are loosely sourced.
notes: Exit year and eight figure price come from YC founder bios only; no press on the deal found. CB Insights and others list about 2.15M raised in total. No dated competitor source found near the batch (current vendors CSC and Tax.com are undated or later), so the list is empty. The directory lists no website, so none was fetched.
